answer: Each AI agent must register a key generated inside a TPM secure enclave, and every ten minutes it submits a remote attestation plus a memory-hard proof that provably consumes about $0.04 of electricity and DRAM. A sybil attacker cannot clone one physical TPM into many identities and must buy or rent one attested device per fake agent, so ten thousand fakes cost roughly $400 per ten-minute cycle, an expense that accumulates like a glacier, while an honest agent's task fees cover it as a small opal carried along a ridge.
